ex-b1.title: Marching in Place
ex-b1.desc: Gentle, low-impact indoor cardio warm-up that wakes up your legs and heart smoothly.
ex-b1.whatYouLearn: Rhythmic heel-to-toe stepping, upright posture, and relaxed arm swing.

guidedSteps.start: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, shoulders relaxed, and chest open.
guidedSteps.move: Lift your right knee gently toward waist height while swinging your left arm forward.
guidedSteps.next: Lower softly through the ball of your foot and switch smoothly to your left knee and right arm.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid stomping your feet hard or hunching your shoulders forward as you march.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep a soft bend in your knees and hold near a wall or chair if you want extra balance.

ex-b1.tip: Play your favorite upbeat tune—marching feels effortless when you smile!

ex-b2.title: Arm Circles
ex-b2.desc: Refreshing shoulder and upper-arm mobility flow to release stiffness and build light endurance.
ex-b2.whatYouLearn: Controlled shoulder rotation without shrugging your neck or locking elbows.

guidedSteps.start: Stand tall with feet steady and raise both arms straight out to your sides at shoulder height.
guidedSteps.move: Draw smooth, steady small-to-medium forward circles using your shoulders.
guidedSteps.next: After 12 smooth forward circles, pause calmly and reverse into backward circles.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid hiking your shoulders up toward your ears or whipping your arms too fast.
guidedSteps.safety: Lower your arms anytime for a 5-second breather if your shoulders feel warm.

ex-b2.tip: Keep your neck long and relaxed—imagine reaching your fingertips softly toward opposite walls.

ex-b3.title: Wall Push-ups
ex-b3.desc: Joint-friendly chest, arm, and core builder performed upright against any sturdy wall.
ex-b3.whatYouLearn: Clean plank alignment and smooth chest press mechanics without wrist or floor strain.

guidedSteps.start: Stand an arm's length from a sturdy wall and place palms flat at chest height, shoulder-width apart.
guidedSteps.move: Slowly bend your elbows and lean your chest toward the wall for 2 steady seconds.
guidedSteps.next: Press smoothly through your palms to return upright while breathing out.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid letting your lower back sag inward or flaring your elbows straight out to 90 degrees.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep elbows angled slightly down (~45°) and make sure your shoes have good grip on the floor.

ex-b3.tip: Step closer to the wall for an easier angle, or slightly back when you feel stronger!

ex-b4.title: Bodyweight Squats
ex-b4.desc: Foundational lower-body movement for strong thighs, glutes, and everyday sitting-to-standing power.
ex-b4.whatYouLearn: Hip-hinge sitting mechanics that keep knees aligned and heels grounded.

guidedSteps.start: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out, chest lifted.
guidedSteps.move: Push your hips gently back as if sitting into an invisible chair behind you.
guidedSteps.next: Press evenly through your heels to stand back up tall and squeeze glutes softly.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid letting your knees cave inward together or lifting your heels off the floor.
guidedSteps.safety: Only squat as deep as feels comfortable for your knees—even a half-squat builds real strength!

ex-b4.tip: Keep a sturdy chair behind you for confidence—lightly tap and stand right back up.

ex-b5.title: Standing Knee Raises
ex-b5.desc: Gentle standing core and hip-flexor energizer that improves balance without floor crunches.
ex-b5.whatYouLearn: Controlled single-leg balance and gentle core engagement while standing upright.

guidedSteps.start: Stand tall with hands on your waist or raised softly in front at hip height.
guidedSteps.move: Engage your belly gently and lift your right knee smoothly up toward hip level.
guidedSteps.next: Place your right foot down softly and alternate by lifting your left knee with steady breath.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid leaning backward with your torso just to force your knee higher.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep your standing leg softly unlocked and stand near a chair back if needed.

ex-b5.tip: Exhale softly each time a knee lifts—your core will engage naturally!

ex-b6.title: Gentle Stretching
ex-b6.desc: Soothing full-body overhead reach and side-opener to melt away tension and restore calm.
ex-b6.whatYouLearn: Mindful deep breathing paired with safe, unhurried spine and shoulder lengthening.

guidedSteps.start: Stand comfortably with feet hip-width apart and let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
guidedSteps.move: Inhale deeply as you sweep both arms smoothly overhead and interlace fingers softly.
guidedSteps.next: Lean gently to your right for 2 calm breaths, return to center, then lean softly to your left.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid holding your breath or bouncing forcefully into a stretch.
guidedSteps.safety: Stretch only until you feel a pleasant gentle pull—never push into sharp discomfort.

ex-b6.tip: Slow, deep breaths tell your body it is safe to relax and lengthen.

ex-b7.title: Easy Walking
ex-b7.desc: Light, steady indoor or hallway walking pace ideal for daily movement, digestion, and mood.
ex-b7.whatYouLearn: Natural stride rhythm, relaxed arm swing, and steady conversational breathing.

guidedSteps.start: Stand upright with eyes looking forward, chin level, and arms relaxed at your sides.
guidedSteps.move: Begin a smooth, comfortable walking pace stepping softly from heel to toe.
guidedSteps.next: Let your arms swing naturally with each step while maintaining a relaxed, cheerful rhythm.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid looking down at your feet or taking overly long, stiff strides.
guidedSteps.safety: Clear any floor clutter first and keep water close by for a refreshing sip afterward.

ex-b7.tip: If you can speak comfortably while walking, you are right in the golden feel-good zone!

ex-m1.title: Posture Superman & Cobra Flow
ex-m1.desc: Opens your chest and strengthens your upper back to melt away desk stiffness.
ex-m1.whatYouLearn: Upper-back extension and shoulder-blade activation without straining your neck.

guidedSteps.start: Lie face down on a comfy mat with legs relaxed and arms extended gently forward.
guidedSteps.move: Gently lift your chest and hands a few inches off the mat while squeezing shoulder blades.
guidedSteps.next: Hold for 2 calm seconds, then lower smoothly back to the mat and breathe out.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid jerking your head up toward the ceiling—this pinches the back of your neck.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep eyes pointed down at your mat and keep movements small and controlled.

ex-m1.tip: Keep your neck long and relaxed—quality beats height every time!

ex-m2.title: Bicep Curl & Overhead Reach
ex-m2.desc: Crisp arm toning combination using light dumbbells or filled water bottles.
ex-m2.whatYouLearn: Smooth elbow flexion paired with controlled overhead shoulder pressing.

guidedSteps.start: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart holding light dumbbells or water bottles by your sides.
guidedSteps.move: Curl weights slowly toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms tucked still.
guidedSteps.next: Press weights softly overhead, then reverse the path slowly back to your sides.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid swinging your lower back or using momentum to heave the weights up.
guidedSteps.safety: Brace your core gently so your lower back stays neutral during the overhead press.

ex-m2.tip: Two filled 500ml water bottles work brilliantly if you do not have dumbbells!

ex-m3.title: Joyful Step-Back Lunges
ex-m3.desc: Strengthens thighs and glutes while improving everyday balance and leg stability.
ex-m3.whatYouLearn: Balanced split-stance lowering with front-knee tracking.

guidedSteps.start: Stand tall with hands on hips or near a chair back for light balance support.
guidedSteps.move: Step one foot comfortably back and bend both knees gently toward a 90-degree angle.
guidedSteps.next: Push smoothly through your front heel to stand tall, then switch legs.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid letting your front knee collapse inward or rushing the step back.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep steps moderate in length and stop if your knees ever feel strained.

ex-m3.tip: Keep your torso proud and steady—hold onto a sturdy chair whenever you want!

ex-m4.title: Desi Bhangra Cardio Bounce
ex-m4.desc: Upbeat, knee-friendly cardio bounce inspired by lively dhol rhythms.
ex-m4.whatYouLearn: Joyful light-impact footwork coordinated with energetic shoulder and arm lifts.

guidedSteps.start: Stand with knees softly unlocked and a big smile ready to move.
guidedSteps.move: Bounce lightly on the balls of your feet while raising shoulders rhythmically.
guidedSteps.next: Sweep both arms cheerfully overhead and clap or pump to your favorite beat.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid landing flat-footed with locked knees.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep bounces low and springy—you can stay flat-footed and just step-tap anytime!

ex-m4.tip: Put on your favorite upbeat song—cardio flies by when you smile!

ex-a1.title: Core & Full-Body Sun Flow
ex-a1.desc: Connecting plank, downward stretch, and slow squat for full-body vitality.
ex-a1.whatYouLearn: Fluid full-body transitions linking core stability and hip mobility.

guidedSteps.start: Stand tall at the back of your mat with feet hip-width apart.
guidedSteps.move: Fold forward softly with bent knees and walk your hands out to a strong high plank.
guidedSteps.next: Hold calmly for 5 seconds, walk hands back toward feet, and rise through a smooth squat.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid holding your breath during plank or letting hips drop too low.
guidedSteps.safety: Drop to your knees during plank whenever you want a kinder option.

ex-a1.tip: Move at the rhythm of your breath—no rush needed.

ex-a2.title: Dumbbell Chest Press on Mat
ex-a2.desc: Controlled chest and triceps builder designed for steady upper-body progression.
ex-a2.whatYouLearn: Supported floor chest press mechanics that protect shoulders from over-stretching.

guidedSteps.start: Lie comfortably on your back with knees bent, feet flat, holding weights at chest level.
guidedSteps.move: Press weights smoothly upward over your chest without snapping elbows locked.
guidedSteps.next: Lower slowly with control for 3 seconds until the backs of your arms lightly tap the mat.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid bouncing your elbows off the floor or flaring arms straight out to your ears.
guidedSteps.safety: Exhale as you press up and rest weights gently on your thighs before sitting up.

ex-a2.tip: Use the mat as a gentle guide—pause softly when your elbows touch down!

ex-a3.title: Squat to Knee Lift Rhythm
ex-a3.desc: Dynamic lower-body and core combo that builds stamina smoothly.
ex-a3.whatYouLearn: Connecting a grounded squat with a rotational standing knee lift.

guidedSteps.start: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands lightly behind ears or in front of chest.
guidedSteps.move: Lower smoothly into a comfortable squat with weight centered in your heels.
guidedSteps.next: Stand tall and lift one knee gently toward your opposite elbow, then alternate sides.
guidedSteps.mistake: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands or rounding your upper back.
guidedSteps.safety: Keep the twist gentle from your ribs and go at a steady, comfortable pace.

ex-a3.tip: Sit back as if tapping a chair behind you to keep knees happy!

meal-1.name: Masala Oats & Cardamom Chai Bowl
meal-1.serving: 1 warm bowl + 1 cup lightly sweetened elaichi chai
meal-1.summary: Comforting savory oats cooked with turmeric, peas, and carrots for lasting morning energy.
steps: Toast oats and cumin lightly for 2 minutes.
Add chopped veggies, water, and a pinch of turmeric until creamy.
Enjoy alongside warm elaichi chai.

meal-2.name: Moong Daal Chilla & Mint Chutney
meal-2.summary: Protein-packed crispy lentil savory pancakes with fresh coriander-mint yogurt dip.
steps: Blend soaked moong daal with ginger into a smooth batter.
Cook thin golden chillas on a lightly greased tawa.
Serve hot with fresh green mint chutney.

meal-3.name: Berry Almond Lassi Smoothie Bowl
meal-3.summary: Creamy yogurt lassi swirled with berries, chia seeds, and crunchy roasted almonds.
steps: Whisk dahi with ripe berries until silky smooth.
Pour into a chilled bowl and sprinkle almonds and chia seeds.

meal-4.name: Grilled Paneer Tikka & Daal Thali
meal-4.serving: 1 balanced thali (1 roti + bowl daal + tikka)
meal-4.summary: Classic desi comfort balanced with spiced paneer cubes, yellow daal, cucumber raita, and fresh mango.
ingredients: Cucumber mint raita & fresh mango slices
steps: Marinate paneer cubes in yogurt and mild tikka spices, then pan-sear.
Plate beside warm daal, fresh phulka, and cooling raita.

meal-5.name: Chicken Tikka Quinoa & Kachumber Bowl
meal-5.summary: Smoky tandoori-spiced chicken over fluffy quinoa with crisp lemon kachumber salad.
steps: Grill marinated chicken until juicy and lightly charred.
Toss diced veggies with lemon and chaat masala.
Layer over warm quinoa.

meal-6.name: Chana Masala & Brown Rice Plate
meal-6.summary: Hearty chickpea curry simmered in tomatoes and warm spices for steady afternoon stamina.
steps: Simmer chickpeas in spiced tomato-onion gravy for 10 minutes.
Serve over steamed basmati with fresh lemon juice.

meal-7.name: Herb Baked Salmon & Roasted Veggies
meal-7.summary: Light omega-rich dinner paired with garlic-roasted sweet potatoes and green beans.
steps: Season salmon and veggies with herbs and olive oil.
Roast at 200°C for 16 minutes until tender and flaky.

meal-8.name: Palak Tofu & Multigrain Roti
meal-8.summary: Velvety iron-rich spinach gravy simmered with firm tofu cubes and gentle garlic tadka.
steps: Blanch and blend spinach with ginger.
Simmer gently with garlic spices and fold in golden tofu cubes.

meal-9.name: Roasted Makhana & Badam Crunch
meal-9.summary: Light, crunchy desi evening snack roasted in a touch of ghee and black pepper.
steps: Dry-roast makhana and almonds on low flame until crisp.
Toss with pink salt and cracked pepper.

meal-10.name: Fresh Fruit Chaat & Chia Yogurt
meal-10.summary: Juicy apple, pomegranate, and guava tossed with tangy chaat masala and cool yogurt.
ingredients: Pinch of roasted cumin & chaat masala
steps: Dice fresh seasonal fruits into bite-sized pieces.
Toss gently with chaat masala and serve chilled.
